text.title: CLI / MCP / Neither Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing one source at a time. Run it per source, not per agent; most sources terminate in the first two branches.

decision-tree.root-question: For this one source: does a command-line path exist, and can the agent execute commands?

branch.when: cli_available == true AND agent_can_execute == true AND structural_blocker == false

conclusion.verdict: Route CLI. Record the binary. Cost is proportional to use, nothing is added to every future request, and the trust boundary is unchanged. Stop here for this source.

branch.when: cli_available == true AND structural_blocker == false AND reason_is_preference == true

conclusion.verdict: Still CLI. 'Nicer', 'more structured', 'the official integration' and 'everyone does it' are preferences, and a preference does not buy a charge levied on every request. Write the preference down and route CLI anyway.
MCP is available for this source. Record the justification verbatim from the closed list, plus first_party, credential_scope and spec_revision, and check the source still fits under server_cap.

branch.when: structural_blocker not in the closed list

conclusion.verdict: Route CLI, or `neither` with a reason. A blocker outside the four named cases is an inconvenience, and the list stays closed precisely so that this branch cannot be argued around.
Do NOT issue credentials. A third-party server sees every request and response it brokers, including the credential. Route to the vendor's own CLI, or `neither` until a first-party server exists.

branch.when: mcp_routed == true AND spec_revision < '2026-07-28' AND depends_on_sampling_roots_or_logging == true

conclusion.verdict: Record a dated migration_deadline inside the twelve-month clock, or route CLI now. A server that passes its own tests today and depends on a deprecated capability fails on somebody else's schedule.

STOP. Do not raise the cap to fit the set; re-run this tree over the lowest-value MCP-routed source and move it to CLI. If deferred loading is what makes the set fit, record the fallback for a definition the agent never fetched.
Invalid, regardless of branch. The registry has been in preview since 2025-09-08 and reviews nothing. Replace the justification with one from the closed list or route elsewhere.
